# Data Cleaning Side-Quest

## Data: Voter Frequency {.smaller}

-   [Info about data](https://github.com/fivethirtyeight/data/tree/master/non-voters)
-   **Goal**: Identify individuals who are unlikely to vote to help an organization target "get out the vote" efforts
-   Create a jupyter notebook or quarto document and load the dataset using this code snippet:

```{r}
#| eval: false
voter_url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fivethirtyeight/data/master/non-voters/nonvoters_data.csv'
voter_raw = pd.read_csv(voter_url)
```

Spend ~2 minutes looking at the dataframe - what do you notice about the general structure?

## Exploring the Data

- In group of about 4, split up the variables and explore them:
    +   What are the different columns? Which ones are categorical vs. ordinal vs. numeric?
    +   What do the different values mean? 
    +   Are there any "missing" values?
    +   Do you notice anything weird?
    +   Discuss the following questions:
        *   If someone doesn't answer a question, is that the same as the question not being asked? Should we treat these the same way?
